snapshot.name: father_christmas.z80
snapshot.note: Official Father Christmas Game, The (1989)(Alternative).z80, the 48K game stopped at its options menu with the tune playing; the archive has no 128K release.

recordings.name: s1.rzx
recordings.role: Scripted keyboard play in level 1 from the menu. The broken builds and the ABI cases use its first 2,500 frames.

recordings.name: full1.rzx
recordings.role: Clean scripted keyboard walk in level 1: name wheel, rooms, ladders, the table, elves; 9,200 frames.

recordings.name: full2.rzx
recordings.role: A second clean scripted walk in level 1, another seed; 9,200 frames.

recordings.name: deep1.rzx
recordings.role: A test fixture with pokes (infinite time, level 1 marked done), scripted play through levels 2 and 3 with the overlay off; 19,072 frames; coverage, not clean play.

verify.note: At every hook every register with R and all 48K RAM (stack too) and the port writes against the original; the Layer 2 picture against an independent model read from the game's graphics at every flip, and every lit pixel against the ULA bitmap; ABI cases on s1's states and 10 broken builds. Pace, soak, flicker, beam audit and the real loader are in games/father_christmas.md "Evidence".

status.title: The Official Father Christmas Game
status.build: v1.0; father_christmas_sprites.nex 227268fe equals the published .nxc 1.0 bare build; level 1's clash removed: the original bitmap and attributes on the ULA, Santa and the elves in their own white on a double-buffered Layer 2 in the game's plot order; levels 2 and 3 as the original; top bank 47, fits a 1MB Next
status.software: 4 recordings, 47,174 frames, 64,585 hooks with R and 48K RAM, 15,617 Layer 2 pictures and 7,675,258 pixels against the model and the ULA bitmap; 640 ABI cases, 10 of 10 broken builds; ROM paths complete (Next ROM 8c34d957); review run: pace in JNext in lockstep, whole runs -0.15% to -0.09%, slowest 20 updates at most +0.67%; 15-minute soaks, flicker, beam audit, real loader on private cards; the flip falls inside the play rows (a moving figure's top rows can lag a frame at the table and ladders)
status.next: hardware checklist; the owner's play; the flip inside the play rows (a figure's top rows can lag a frame at the table and ladders); Enhanced (mock-up only, figures EASY)

results.scope: runs/official_father_christmas/release-20261108: pace, soak, flicker, beam audit and real loader, JNext 1.1.104, on this engine's bytes. Not a selftest stamp.
